name: finmeta-plugin
description: FinMeta client plugin — 5 skills: simulation trading (A-Share / US Stock / Crypto: market data, accounts, orders), market-data (symbols/quotes/kline, read-only), watchlist (user stock pool: read/add/remove per market), invoke-api-agent (call type=api agents), finmeta-task-agent (call task agents via A2A).
